title: Collatz Sequence Explorer
description: Run the 3n+1 Collatz sequence from any start: full path, step count, max value and a bar chart.
howto: Read the step count, peak value, chart and the full sequence.

faqs.a: That every positive integer reaches 1 by repeatedly halving evens and applying 3n+1 to odds — unproven but verified to huge bounds.
It takes 111 steps and climbs to 9,232 before falling to 1 — surprisingly wild for such a small start.
Each bar is a sequence value on a log scale, so both the huge spikes and the final descent stay visible.
